name: superpowers-lite
description: A lightweight engineering workflow router and skill set for coding agents.
author: lightless233
skillInstructions: Within this plugin, references written as `superpowers-lite:<skill-name>` refer to the plugin Skill named `<skill-name>`. Load that Skill with Kimi Code's Skill mechanism. Users can invoke it manually with `/skill:<skill-name>`.

interface.shortDescription: Route engineering work through the lightest reliable workflow.
interface.longDescription: A lightweight set of skills for design, specification, planning, debugging, testing, and verification without mandatory ceremony.
